chunks.heading: Does Nimbus work without an internet connection?
chunks.text: Locally-evaluated routines and manual device control over the local network keep working during an outage. Remote access, cloud recording, and voice assistants require the cloud connection.

chunks.heading: Why am I hitting rate limit errors?
chunks.text: You are exceeding your plan's allowed API requests per minute; see the API rate limits table in the pricing documentation for your plan's exact limit.

chunks.heading: How many active routines can I have?
chunks.text: Each account can have up to 50 active routines, per the automation limits section of the automations guide.

chunks.heading: Can I export all of my data?
chunks.text: Yes, from Settings > Data Export you can download a CSV export containing your devices, rooms, and automations.

chunks.heading: Is there a public status page?
chunks.text: status.nimbus.example shows current uptime and a history of past incidents.
